reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29 with the Accountable dashboard response timestamped 1788032164478 (2026-08-29T19:36:04.478Z). The reserves_split values are STRC $182,766,520.57, Inventory $49,117,020.71, Protocol Owned Liquidity $48,028,974.73, Cash & Equivalents $29,358,512.37, and Other $6,209.75 against total reserves $309,277,238.14 and total supply $312,073,514.82. The live accountable adapter emits the four positive buckets at one decimal (59.1%, 15.9%, 15.5%, and 9.5%); the $6,209.75 Other bucket is below the adapter's one-decimal output threshold. Gross reserve coverage is 99.104%, while the dashboard's net-of-protocol-owned collateralization is 0.98699. STRC is corroborated by the linked July Wolf & Company examination, but Inventory and Protocol Owned Liquidity remain opaque and Cash & Equivalents combines USDC with Treasury bills.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Timestamped Accountable reserves_split snapshot (2026-08-29) normalized by the current accountable live-reserve adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Inventory and Protocol Owned Liquidity do not disclose constituent assets; Cash & Equivalents cannot be split between USDC and Treasury bills; and the adapter-suppressed Other bucket is not itemized. The July 2026 Wolf & Company report corroborates Preference Foundation securities but does not reconcile all apxUSD liabilities.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Apyx states it works with custodians monthly to obtain attestations that backing assets exist and remain under custody control (Wolf & Company opinions published for March-June 2026 on the third-party attestation index), but the custodian identities, account segregation terms, bankruptcy-remoteness structure, and rehypothecation permissions are not disclosed in the reviewed documentation. The refreshed 2026-08-27 reserves_split places the protocol-controlled Inventory (15.5%) and Protocol Owned Liquidity (15.4%) buckets at 30.9% combined, with no stated custody arrangement.
